issue.title: Refine weather composition into a compact multi-day forecast
issue.description:
Refine the weather gallery composition to match a cleaner two-zone weather-card structure inspired by the owner's reference, while preserving Personal UI semantic-token behavior.

Owner direction:

* Replace the current weather composition structure with a simpler horizontal weather-summary layout.
* Preserve the same overall information hierarchy as the reference, but express it through Personal UI semantic tokens rather than copying the reference's fixed dark styling.
* Keep the card suitable for the wider Weather slot beside the compact Calendar from <issue id="96367743-1b69-4c38-8db5-a83f3b2818cc" href="https://linear.app/emman-systems/issue/PUI-97/simplify-calendar-card-and-pair-it-with-the-weather-composition">PUI-97</issue>.

Top zone:
Use one horizontal summary row with:

* weather-condition icon on the far left;
* large current temperature beside the icon;
* compact stacked high/low values next to the current temperature;
* location name and current condition right-aligned on the far right.

Example structure:
\[weather icon\]  30°   H 35°                 Toronto
                    L 16°              Partly Cloudy

Remove from the current composition:

* location-pin icon treatment;
* "Sample forecast · not live data" copy;
* the separate large weather icon currently floating on the right;
* the hourly strip with Now / times;
* Wind;
* Humidity;
* Sunset;
* separators associated with those lower detail blocks.

Bottom zone:
Add a simple multi-day forecast row distributed evenly across the card width.

Each forecast column should contain only:

1. day label;
2. weather icon;
3. high temperature;
4. low temperature.

Use a restrained set of upcoming days, approximately 5–6 columns, depending on available width and browser evidence.

Example conceptually:
WED      THU      FRI      SAT      SUN      MON
☁        ☀        ☁        ☀        ☀        ☀
\-3°      -1°      -9°      -4°      -4°      -4°
\-6°      -9°     -10°      -6°      -6°      -6°

Data / behavior constraints:

* Keep using deterministic illustrative local data only.
* Do not add geolocation, weather APIs, live network calls, credentials, or external services.
* Do not claim the values are live.
* Keep the composition geometry stable.
* No workflow-heavy interaction is needed.

Design-system constraints:

* Use Personal UI semantic tokens for background, text, borders, accents, and muted states.
* Preserve light/dark rendering.
* Use Heading / Body / Mono typography roles appropriately.
* Avoid arbitrary raw colors when semantic tokens exist.
* Use existing icon infrastructure where practical.
* Do not create a new public Weather resource solely for this gallery composition unless genuinely reusable.

Layout relationship to <issue id="96367743-1b69-4c38-8db5-a83f3b2818cc" href="https://linear.app/emman-systems/issue/PUI-97/simplify-calendar-card-and-pair-it-with-the-weather-composition">PUI-97</issue>:

* Weather remains the wider member of the Calendar + Weather paired row.
* Calendar remains the more compact/narrower member.
* Exact proportions remain implementation-owned rather than fixed percentages.
* Allow responsive stacking at narrower container widths.
* The new horizontal weather structure should take advantage of the wider slot without forcing overflow.

Do not:

* reintroduce the removed hourly forecast strip;
* reintroduce Wind/Humidity/Sunset blocks;
* add explanatory title/subtitle copy above the weather summary;
* alter the Calendar or Music compositions in this ticket;
* change broader gallery architecture;
* introduce real network-backed weather functionality.

Acceptance:

* Weather card uses the simplified two-zone composition: top current-weather summary + bottom multi-day forecast.
* Top row includes weather icon, large current temperature, compact high/low values, and right-aligned location/condition.
* The current location-pin treatment and sample-data subtitle are removed.
* Hourly forecast strip is removed.
* Wind, Humidity, and Sunset sections are removed.
* Bottom forecast row shows day, icon, high, and low only.
* Forecast items are distributed evenly and remain readable at the Weather card's wider layout size.
* Deterministic illustrative data remains local-only.
* Light/dark/theme-token responsiveness remains intact.
* No overflow, focus-order, accessibility, or responsive regression.
